title: Hīkoi Bounce (336 Jersey)
style: jersey club meets te reo māori bounce, 140 BPM, classic jersey club bed-squeak sample on the offbeat, hard kick pattern with characteristic five-note jersey bounce, sub-bass with quick stab pattern, female vocal chops with te reo phrases pitched up and stuttered, soft poi-rhythm log drum accents on the breakdown, taonga pūoro flute samples chopped into the drops, gang-shout backing on the hook, sun-soaked Tamaki Makaurau bounce mood, 336 hz subharmonic drone hidden under the sub stab, vinyl crackle on the breakdowns, no auto-tune on the lead, big hyperpop bounce energy, short and catchy
lyrics:
[Intro — bed-squeak loop, kick drops in]
(spoken) Hīkoi. Bounce. Three-three-six. Jersey.

[Verse 1 — stuttered female vocal chops]
Hī-hī-hīkoi, bounce on the wire
Tēnā-tēnā koe, kick on the fire
Mauri-mauri ora, bed-squeak on the snare
Three-three-six, te reo in the air

[Pre-drop — build, kick stutters, vocal chops pitch up]
Hīkoi-hīkoi-hīkoi, the bounce is the walk
Kia ora, kia ora, the kick is the talk
B-b-b-bounce, three-three-six in the sub
Taonga pūoro chop, jersey on the dub

[DROP — jersey kick + bed-squeak + vocal chops]
HĪKOI BOUNCE — THREE-THREE-SIX JERSEY
TĒNĀ KOE — KIA ORA — BOUNCE
HĪKOI BOUNCE — THREE-THREE-SIX JERSEY
MAURI ORA — BOUNCE — BOUNCE
(Backing chops): hī — hī — koi — bounce — bounce —

[Verse 2 — short, stuttered]
Tāmaki Makaurau to the Tasman wide
Kangaroo on the kick, kiwi on the slide
Whakarongo ki te tai, listen to the tide
Three-three-six, jersey on the ride

[Bridge — half-time, log drum + flute chops]
(spoken te reo) Ko ngā waiata ngā mapi
Ko ngā waiata ngā hoa
The songs are the maps, the songs are friends
Bounce — bounce — bounce

[DROP final — full jersey kick + gang shouts]
HĪKOI BOUNCE — THREE-THREE-SIX JERSEY
TĒNĀ KOE — KIA ORA — BOUNCE
HĪKOI BOUNCE — THREE-THREE-SIX JERSEY

[Outro — bed-squeak fades]
Hīkoi. Bounce. Three-three-six.
Jersey. Kīwhai. Done.
